source: FDM Bible ("Bible de l'impression 3D FDM", focused on PrusaSlicer settings) + Prusa official docs

PLA.notes: Prusa official: 215/210°C nozzle, 60°C bed. High fan. MVS ~15 mm³/s.

PETG.notes: Prusa official: 230/240°C nozzle, 85/90°C bed. Moderate fan. MVS ~8 mm³/s.

ABS.notes: Prusa official: 255°C nozzle, 100°C bed (80-110). Enclosure required. MVS ~11 mm³/s.

ASA.notes: Prusa official: 260°C nozzle, 105/110°C bed. UV resistant. MVS ~11 mm³/s.

TPU.notes: Prusa official: 220-240°C nozzle, 55-75°C bed. MVS ~1-2.5 mm³/s. Direct drive recommended.

NYLON.notes: Prusa official: 285°C nozzle, 110°C bed. Hygroscopic. Dry 12h@80°C.

PC.notes: Prusa official: 275°C nozzle, 110/115°C bed. Enclosure 50°C+. Can tear the sheet surface.

bestPractices.recommendation: Closed enclosure required. Warping priority: enclosure > brim > bed temp.
Closed enclosure, no drafts. Adjust supports/overhang speed rather than fan.
Retraction max 0.8-1mm. MVS ~8 mm³/s. Textured/Satin PEI surface recommended.
Speed capped via MVS (1-2.5 mm³/s). Direct drive recommended. Avoid Smooth PEI without glue.
Drying required (12h@80°C). PA Nylon sheet recommended. Enclosure is critical.
Enclosure at 50°C+ required. Release layer (glue) on Smooth PEI. Check MVS and temperature.
Supports or reorientation needed. Support Z contact = 50-75% of layer height.
Brim 5mm+ for stability. ABS/ASA: enclosure first.
+10-20°C and a higher MVS are possible. If capped by MVS: a lower layer height = 'free detail'.
Lower MVS (more flow resistance). Avoid layers <0.10mm (small gain, long print time). Finer supports.
Diagnostic order: nozzle temp → EM/MVS → retraction → filament moisture → nozzle cleaning.
Diagnostic order: enclosure → bed temp → brim → clean surface (IPA/water).
Order: cold pull/clean the nozzle → lower MVS or raise temp → calibrate EM.
Check belt tension. Review accel/jerk (machine limits).
Adjust Live Z / first layer. Enable Elephant Foot Compensation in PrusaSlicer.
Try aligned/random seam position. Calibrate PA/LA. Recheck EM.

calibrationWorkflow.description: Prusa's official calibration order (FDM Bible). Each step depends on the previous one.

steps.name: Mechanical basics
steps.detail: Belt tension, axes, bearings. Classic cause of layer shift.

steps.name: Thermal stability
steps.detail: PID tuning if the temperature swings ±5°C. M303 for autotune.

steps.name: First layer
steps.detail: Live Adjust Z. Bed +5-10°C if adhesion is marginal. Clean surface (IPA/water).

steps.name: Extrusion
steps.detail: E-steps after an extruder change, otherwise Extrusion Multiplier (official Prusa calibration).

steps.name: Flow (MVS)
steps.detail: Max Volumetric Speed in Filament Settings. PLA~15, PETG~8, ABS~11, TPU~1-2.5 mm³/s.

steps.name: Retraction / Wipe / Z-hop
steps.detail: Printer Settings → Extruder. Max 2mm MK3, 3.2mm MINI bowden.

steps.name: Cooling / Bridges / Overhangs
steps.detail: Fan min/max, dynamic overhang speed. TPU: adjust fan/overhang speed.

steps.name: Pressure Advance (PA/LA)
steps.detail: Advanced calibration. PA replaces LA since firmware 5.0.0 (M572). Needs correct flow first.

steps.name: Acceleration / Jerk / Machine limits
steps.detail: Too high = ringing/layer shift. Too low = long print times.

nozzleSizeRules.notes: Official Prusa rules. Max layer height ≈ 80% of nozzle. Auto extrusion width = 1.125 × nozzle. Usable range = 25%-75% of nozzle.
